newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: PERU TENDERS TO BUY JET FUEL - TRADER.
newsitem.headline: PERU TENDERS TO BUY JET FUEL - TRADER.

text.p: Peru's state oil company Petroperu has issued a tender to buy a cargo of 200,000 barrels of jet aviation fuel for delivery in the first week of September, a trader said on Friday.

The company has already covered its supplies of diesel for August and September through a purchase tender for four cargoes won by Venezuela's Maraven. Three diesel cargoes are expected to be delivered in August and one in September, traders said.
The company is a regular buyer of refined products to supply its domestic retail system.
